content: Human-labeling session — lh-recovery-after-mid-game-loss:hard seed 1. Objective: Commander, your forward Soviet base — Construction Yard, Ore Refinery, Power Plant, an Ore Truck and two rifle defenders — and your deep-west home base — parked Mobile Construction Vehicle, Power Plant, lone rifleman — both spawn at a seed- chosen latitude (NORTH or SOUTH band of the map). Enemy ground rush bands close from the east at both latitudes; reinforcement waves keep arriving at both latitudes through the run. Cash: $1600. Win bar: a Construction Yard AND an Ore Refinery, both standing inside the deep-west disc matched to YOUR latitude (radius 8 around the safe zone), AND at least one of your units alive, within about fifty turns. A memorised mid-map rebuild satisfies neither latitude. Total loss of every Construction Yard you own is an immediate fail.
